newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CORPGRO FINALISES MATADOR ACQUISITION.
newsitem.headline: CORPGRO FINALISES MATADOR ACQUISITION.

text.p: Industrial holding group CorpGro Ltd said on Thursday some 86.58 million shares would be issued to pay for its acquisition of Matador Refrigeration (Pty) Ltd.
The company said in a statement that it had placed some 62.54 million of the shares with third parties at 26 cents per share.

In terms of the agreement, Matador had undertaken to settle some 10 million rand of its borrowings. This would allow Matador to focus on its core business as well as grow its business in a properly structured financial environment, it said.
CorpGro advised shareholders that negotiations regarding further acquisitions were taking place and shareholders should continue to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
